# `PathObjectRef`

**Kind:** class  
**Module/package:** `models`  
**SDK:** `pdfdancer-client-typescript 3.0.0`

Represents a path object reference with styling information.
Extends ObjectRef to include stroke/fill colors and stroke properties.
